WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), shares AS (
    SELECT event_id,
           attendance_count,
           CAST(attendance_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(attendance_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM per_event
)
SELECT event_id, attendance_count, share
FROM shares
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
